description: This file defines the JsonRPCServer class which implements a JSON Remote Procedure Call server for SuiteCRM. It handles JSON-RPC requests, manages session and request processing, and interacts with utility classes for authentication and method calls.

classes.name: JsonRPCServer
classes.description: Implements a JSON-RPC server for SuiteCRM, managing request processing, authentication, and invoking relevant RPC methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the JSON parser, utility, and call handler objects.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main method to run the JSON-RPC server, manages session and request handling.

methods.name: processRequest
methods.description: Processes a JSON-RPC request, handles authentication, validates request parameters, and invokes the appropriate method.
